_about: What changed, newest first. The daily refresh adds one entry per run (see tools/DAILY-LOADOUTS.md), even when nothing changed, so the home page can show when the site was last checked. area is one of Loadouts, Warzone, Rules, Maps, Site. Keep each line short and plain. Keep the newest 30 entries.

items.text: Re-checked on wzstats.gg and warzoneloadout.games. No tier moves and no build changes for the 29 weapons already listed, and the top six are the same.
The Type 73 stays on the page. warzoneloadout.games still shows no build for it, so its build is now the one on wzstats.gg, which has the same five attachments.
Oris 8.6 added in C tier, with the build from wzstats.gg. 30 weapons in all.
Re-checked. No changes. YouTube could not be read for a fourth day, so the pro classes are as last confirmed on Nov 17.

warzoneloadout.games still shows no build for the Type 73, so its build is the one read on Nov 16. Today is its last day on the page unless it can be read again.

Nine more weapons listed after the trackers added them: Oden, Krait P68, Rezi 12, Warlord, APOC-338, Signal 50, MAR-9, Sang 9mm and Mojave .357. 29 weapons in all.
Hyeon Burst, Cronen Squall and FiNN LMG move up from B to A, and the Patriot XMR from C to B, after wzstats.gg put them in its A tier. The top six are unchanged.

Ranked classes rebuilt from what pros are running now: HAN 86, VEL 46, ISO Nightshade and M4, each checked against the Ranked and CMG rules.
Tiers and builds re-read from wzstats.gg and warzoneloadout.games: 20 weapons.
New Match Night and Squad pages, and the loadout pages now look like the in-game class screen.
Detailed callouts added to Lotus, Lithium, Munition, Reactor U92, Rooftops and Sentry. A Callouts button on the map shows all, main only or none, and Edit names lets you rename them.
Pros agreed to stop using the VEL 46 long barrel. The pro VEL 46 build now uses the light barrel.
A few pros started testing the ISO Nightshade.
CMG Arena: Hardpoint respawn delay set to 2.5 seconds.
CMG Arena: smokes banned in respawn modes.
